scope: All 28 current macro and fixture configurations have fresh isolated FreeCAD proofs. The parallel variants explicitly use reworked M3 disc accessories, a raised rocker boss and upper shaft-end case contacts. All external pairs, source-disc identity and new internal fit, nominal clearances, retention displacement controls and independent STEP/FCStd roundtrips passed. The exact-hash open-cover case was rerun with a conservatively expanded rotation envelope that also contains the lower disc spline boss. Inherited supplier contact and retaining-thread limitations remain documented; geometry is not a force or fatigue qualification.
